name: Bishoujo Miku Natsuyasumi Kaikan Nikki
original_name: 美少女みく・なつやすみ快感日記
source:
One day, our protagonist came back to the time when he was young and popular.

He  will not let the story repeat twice and will start to go out with a classmate.
